categories_thin: Optometrists/vision: none confirmed inside the borough; Dunellen-zip eye doctors found sit on the US-22 corridor (Green Brook/North Plainfield side), which NJTGO deliberately excludes.
Veterinarians and pet boarding: none inside the borough; the nearest clinics are on Washington Ave in Green Brook and on Stelton Rd in Piscataway.

Hardware, bike, music-instrument and appliance retail: no such storefront found; non-food retail is limited to three florists, a clothing boutique, a candle studio, a trading-card shop, a dated gift shop and upholstery.
Tutoring/test prep and driving schools: only regional or in-home services cover Dunellen; no storefront in town.

Electrical contractors: only Able Electrical Contracting could be tied to a Dunellen street address on an accessible listing. BuildZoom's Dunellen electrician directory (the verifier's source for Dominic R. Papa) blocks automated access, so one-person licensed electricians may exist but could not be confirmed.
Independent hotels, moving/storage, wholesale-logistics: none found in the borough; industrial uses are confined to the North Avenue Extension pocket.

Financial/wealth advisers and IT-software firms: no Dunellen-based independent firm surfaced beyond the tax/accounting practices and insurance agencies listed; searches returned only chains and home-based agents.

Landscaping: five Dunellen landscaping firms with active state licences appear on a licence aggregator (NJ Landscaping And Construction LLC, ASV Landscaping Design/Home Improvement LLC, Richard & Sons, Lion Landscaping & Construction LLC, Alvarez Garden & Hardscape LLC) but only Richard & Sons publishes a street address, so the rest were not added as entries.
caveats: Dunellen is a ~1.1 sq mi borough, so the 10-mile radius is satisfied everywhere in the zone; the list is scoped to businesses physically in the borough.

Businesses with a 'Dunellen' mailing address on US Highway 22 are frequently located in Green Brook or North Plainfield. EAB Insurance Group (929 Washington Ave), Williamson Realty (319 US-22) and Mila's Debut School of Music (326 US-22) were removed on that basis after re-checking.

Several directories (Yellow Pages, AllPages, Cylex, BBB, BuildZoom, Angi, WhereOrg, UniLocal) block automated access; where a listing was seen only in a search result this is stated in active_evidence rather than presented as a confirmed page.
Many small salons and trades publish no phone number on any accessible page; those entries carry 'Unknown' rather than a guess.

Google Maps was not re-used as a citation in this revision: generic Maps search URLs do not identify a business, so those citations were replaced with listing pages, or removed together with the detail they supported (several salon ratings).

Chain locations were excluded on purpose: Kessler Rehabilitation, Select Physical Therapy, World Gym, Advance Auto Parts, The UPS Store, Total Wireless, Provident Bank, Ray Pharmacy and Devine's Pharmacy, Sun Power Gas.
data_gaps: Dominic R. Papa (electrical contractor, 431 Third St, Dunellen per BuildZoom) could not be added: BuildZoom returns HTTP 403 to both fetch and the browser, and no other page confirming the business was found.
Easton Mechanical Service Inc.'s street address (14 Woodlawn Ave) comes from a Cylex search listing; the Cylex page itself returned 403, and the opened HVAC list shows a truncated address.
Overpass/OpenStreetMap API did not respond within timeout; OSM was not used.
dunellen411.com loads through the browser but its business list is a short curated page dated around 2020, so it is weak evidence of current operation.

Removed for lack of a business-specific or borough-accurate source: Heritage Insurance Agency NJ (no Dunellen listing found; 12 S Washington Ave is documented as Capital Ink Tattoos), King George Chiropractic Center (309 Rock Ave is in Green Brook Township per Waze and Yellow Pages), Turlip's Garage (marked permanently closed on Birdeye), J.
